property_ids.description: Comma, space, or newline separated GA4 numeric property IDs. Native reads use the first property ID per read call; run separate reads for additional properties.

property_id.description: Optional single GA4 numeric property ID used by provider-style direct commands. Defaults to the first value from property_ids when omitted.

audience_export_id.description: Audience export identifier used by the get audience export direct command.

access_token.description: OAuth2 bearer access token with Analytics Data API read access. Prefer supplying from an environment variable or stdin.

credentials.description: Legacy flattened credential payload or bearer token. Prefer access_token for new credentials; never pass secret values in shell history or chat.

base_url.description: Analytics Data API base URL. Override only for local fixture tests.

date_ranges_start_date.description: GA4 report start date, either YYYY-MM-DD or a GA4 relative token such as 30daysAgo.

date_ranges_end_date.description: GA4 report end date, either YYYY-MM-DD or a GA4 relative token such as today or yesterday.

keep_empty_rows.description: Legacy compatibility flag for GA4 runReport keepEmptyRows behavior; native preset reads currently send false.

convert_conversions_event.description: Legacy compatibility flag for conversion metric coercion.

custom_reports_array.description: Legacy custom report JSON string. Custom reports remain outside this documented parity slice.

lookback_window.description: Legacy lookback-window setting for repeated report reads.

subscription_tier.description: Informational GA4 property tier for quota planning; no connector-local throttle is enforced in this slice.

window_in_days.description: Legacy window setting retained for credential compatibility.

page_size.description: Native runReport page size. Defaults to 10000 and is capped at 250000.

max_pages.description: Native runReport page cap. Use a positive integer, 0, all, or unlimited.

mode.description: Set to fixture for credential-free connector-owned tests. Do not use for live provider validation.
